signal: Sonatype released its 2026 State of the Software Supply Chain report flagging a shift from guidance to enforcement, relevant to federal compliance mandates.

email.body1:
Marc, saw Sonatype's 2026 supply chain report calling out the move from guidance to enforcement on compliance, squarely a federal civilian theme.

Mandate-driven demand creates more agency accounts than a team can touch before budget cycles close. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Sonatype off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your civilian number
email.body2:
Marc, quick follow-up for Sonatype.

When mandates tighten, civilian agencies move, but most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to capture that window. The gap shows up late, and federal timelines are unforgiving when it does.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your federal civilian book needs this fiscal year, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Marc, last bit of proof for Sonatype.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other devsecops vendors selling federal. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Marc, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling federal coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this cycle, no problem at all. Agency procurement timing is its own kind of busy, and I respect that.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a federal civilian motion? I'll tailor it to Sonatype either way.
